Info

Concrete implementation of binary wire response frame builder.

class scaralang.infrastructure.protocol.response.builder.BinaryResponseBuilder(*, packer: IBinaryFramePacker)[source]¶

Bases: object

Builder constructing binary wire response frames using injected frame packer.

It defines:

attributes:
_packer - Injected binary wire frame packer service.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes builder with binary frame packer collaborator.
build_ack - Assembles positive acknowledgment response frame.
build_nack - Assembles negative rejection response frame.
build_status - Assembles consolidated manipulator telemetry response frame.
build_move_event - Assembles motion execution event response frame.
get_version - Returns response builder version string.
_packer: IBinaryFramePacker¶
build_ack(*, cmd_id: MessageId, seq_num: int, free_slots: int) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Constructs an ACK response frame for an executed command.

Parameters:

  • cmd_id – MessageId of acknowledged command.

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index matching inbound frame.

  • free_slots – Available queue capacity slots.

Returns:

Assembled BinaryFrame with packed ACK payload.

Exceptions:

None.

build_move_event(*, seq_num: int, event_type: MoveEventType | int) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Constructs a RESP_MOVE_EVENT binary motion notification frame.

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index matching inbound frame.

  • event_type – Motion event code (MoveEventType or integer).

Returns:

Assembled BinaryFrame with packed MOVE_EVENT payload.

Exceptions:

None.

build_nack(*, cmd_id: MessageId, seq_num: int, error_code: int) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Constructs a NACK rejection response frame for a failed command.

Parameters:

  • cmd_id – MessageId of rejected command.

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index matching inbound frame.

  • error_code – Error reason code.

Returns:

Assembled BinaryFrame with packed NACK payload.

Exceptions:

None.

build_status(*, seq_num: int, status: ManipulatorStatus) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Constructs a STATUS telemetry response frame with motor step positions.

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index matching inbound frame.

  • status – Consolidated manipulator telemetry state model.

Returns:

Assembled BinaryFrame with packed STATUS payload.

Exceptions:

None.

Version string.
